title: Smoothness of the determinant on L(ℝⁿ): T ↦ T.det is C^k for every order k
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ. Let ℝⁿ := Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), and let L(ℝⁿ) := ℝⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝⁿ carry its operator-norm normed-space structure. For every smoothness order k ∈ WithTop ℕ∞ (finite orders, k = ∞ and the analytic order ω = ⊤), the determinant map det : L(ℝⁿ) → ℝ, T ↦ T.det, is C^k (ContDiff ℝ k). Here T.det = ContinuousLinearMap.det T = LinearMap.det of the underlying linear map of T.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : WithTop ℕ∞), ContDiff ℝ k (fun T : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n ↦ T.det)
